easy: To get bigger, louder, or stronger.

ex.en: The music swelled and filled the whole room.
ex.ko: 음악 소리가 점점 커지며 방 전체를 가득 채웠다.

easy: To feel very proud of yourself and act like you are special.

ex.en: He swelled with pride when he won the race.
ex.ko: 그는 달리기에서 이기자 자랑스러워 우쭐해졌다.

easy: If you only think about the idea, not about what really happens.

ex.en: Theoretically, we can finish the puzzle in ten minutes, but it is hard.
ex.ko: 이론상으로는 퍼즐을 십 분 안에 끝낼 수 있지만, 어렵다.

easy: In a way that uses ideas and facts, not real tests.

ex.en: The scientist explained theoretically how rockets fly.
ex.ko: 그 과학자는 로켓이 어떻게 나는지 이론적으로 설명했다.

easy: The feeling that you need to drink water.

ex.en: After the soccer game, my thirst was so big that I drank two cups of water.
ex.ko: 축구 경기 후 갈증이 너무 심해서 물을 두 컵이나 마셨다.

easy: A very strong wish to have or learn something.

ex.en: She has a thirst for knowledge and reads every day.
ex.ko: 그녀는 지식에 대한 갈망이 커서 매일 책을 읽는다.

easy: Happening while something changes into something else.

ex.en: Middle school is a transitional time between little kid and teenager.
ex.ko: 중학교는 어린이에서 청소년으로 넘어가는 과도기이다.

easy: A big fish from warm seas that people eat, often from a can.

ex.en: Mom made a tuna sandwich for my lunch.
ex.ko: 엄마가 내 점심으로 참치 샌드위치를 만들어 주셨다.

easy: Clean and not worn or dirty yet.

ex.en: I opened a new, unused notebook for math class.
ex.ko: 나는 수학 시간에 쓰려고 새것인 안 쓴 공책을 펼쳤다.

easy: Still new because nobody has used it yet.

ex.en: The toy was still unused in its box.
ex.ko: 그 장난감은 상자 안에 아직 쓰지 않은 채로 있었다.

easy: A high place where you can see a wide area.

ex.en: We climbed to the viewpoint and saw the whole lake.
ex.ko: 우리는 전망대에 올라가 호수 전체를 보았다.

easy: A sour liquid people put on salad or use in cooking.

ex.en: Grandma put vinegar on the salad.
ex.ko: 할머니는 샐러드에 식초를 뿌리셨다.

easy: Fake or real hair that you wear on your head.

ex.en: My brother wore a funny rainbow wig on Halloween.
ex.ko: 우리 형은 핼러윈에 우스운 무지개색 가발을 썼다.

easy: Something like a hat, scarf, or bag that you wear or carry with your clothes.

ex.en: A bright scarf is my favorite accessory.
ex.ko: 밝은 스카프는 내가 가장 좋아하는 액세서리이다.

easy: Joining or becoming part of a bigger group.

ex.en: The school's affiliation with the library lets us borrow more books.
ex.ko: 학교가 도서관과 제휴를 맺어서 우리는 책을 더 많이 빌릴 수 있다.

easy: To put things in a straight line or make them fit together.

ex.en: Please align the desks in a straight row.
ex.ko: 책상들을 일렬로 나란히 맞춰 주세요.

easy: A time when people who broke a rule are told they will not be punished.

ex.en: The library had an amnesty week, so late books had no fines.
ex.ko: 도서관이 사면 주간을 열어서 늦게 반납해도 벌금이 없었다.

easy: A black cow with no horns, first raised in Scotland.

ex.en: We saw a black Angus cow on the farm.
ex.ko: 우리는 농장에서 검은 앵거스 소를 보았다.

easy: Something you say very strongly, as if everyone must believe it.

ex.en: His assertion that the dog ate his homework made everyone laugh.
ex.ko: 개가 숙제를 먹었다는 그의 주장에 모두가 웃었다.

easy: The study of stars, planets, and space.

ex.en: I love astronomy because I can learn about the stars.
ex.ko: 나는 별에 대해 배울 수 있어서 천문학이 좋다.

easy: On the top of something.

ex.en: The cat sat atop the fence to watch the birds in the yard.
ex.ko: 고양이는 마당의 새들을 보려고 울타리 꼭대기에 앉았다.

easy: A person who talks or reports on radio or TV.

ex.en: The broadcaster told us about tomorrow's snow on TV.
ex.ko: 방송 진행자가 텔레비전에서 내일 눈이 온다고 알려 주었다.

easy: A religion that follows the teachings of Buddha.

ex.en: Buddhism is a religion that began long ago in Asia.
ex.ko: 불교는 아주 오래전 아시아에서 시작된 종교이다.

easy: Clear and easy to follow when you think or talk.

ex.en: Her story was coherent, so everyone understood it.
ex.ko: 그녀의 이야기는 조리가 있어서 모두가 이해했다.

easy: One home in a building where each home is owned by a different family.

ex.en: Our cousins live in a condo near the beach.
ex.ko: 우리 사촌들은 바닷가 근처 콘도에 산다.

easy: Not matching, so one thing says the opposite of another.

ex.en: The two maps gave conflicting directions, so we got lost.
ex.ko: 두 지도가 서로 다른 길을 알려 줘서 우리는 길을 잃었다.

easy: To say what is wrong or bad about something.

ex.en: Please do not criticize your friend's drawing; say something kind.
ex.ko: 친구의 그림을 비판하지 말고 친절한 말을 해 주세요.

easy: Bending and twisting, not straight.

ex.en: The path through the woods was crooked and hard to follow.
ex.ko: 숲속 길은 구불구불해서 따라가기 어려웠다.

easy: Growing plants and food on land that farmers have prepared.

ex.en: The cultivation of rice needs a lot of water.
ex.ko: 벼 재배에는 물이 많이 필요하다.

easy: A short, clear sound like a small bell.

ex.en: The microwave made a ding when the popcorn was ready.
ex.ko: 팝콘이 다 되자 전자레인지에서 땡 소리가 났다.

easy: A small dent or mark made when something hits a surface.

ex.en: Dad's car got a small ding from a baseball.
ex.ko: 아빠 차가 야구공에 맞아 작은 흠집이 났다.

easy: Not made or sold anymore.

ex.en: The store no longer sells that toy because it is discontinued.
ex.ko: 그 장난감은 단종되어서 가게에서 더 이상 팔지 않는다.

easy: Not showing respect to someone.

ex.en: Talking back to a teacher is disrespect.
ex.ko: 선생님께 말대꾸하는 것은 무례한 행동이다.

easy: Very strong and extreme, often done to fix a big problem.

ex.en: The town took drastic steps to stop the flood.
ex.ko: 마을은 홍수를 막으려고 과감한 조치를 취했다.

easy: Safe to eat.

ex.en: Are these berries edible, or are they poisonous?
ex.ko: 이 열매는 먹을 수 있나요, 아니면 독이 있나요?

easy: To say you like and support someone or something.

ex.en: Our class endorsed Mia for class president.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 미아를 반장으로 지지했다.

easy: To say yes and give your support to a plan or person.

ex.en: The principal endorsed our plan for a school garden.
ex.ko: 교장 선생님은 학교 텃밭을 만들자는 우리 계획을 지지해 주셨다.

easy: A change that makes something better.

ex.en: The new slide was a fun enhancement to our playground.
ex.ko: 새 미끄럼틀은 우리 놀이터를 더 재미있게 만든 개선이었다.

easy: A machine that sends a copy of a paper over a phone line.

ex.en: Dad sent the paper by fax.
ex.ko: 아빠는 그 서류를 팩스로 보냈다.

easy: To send a paper to someone using a special machine and phone line.

ex.en: Please fax the form to the school office.
ex.ko: 그 서식을 학교 사무실로 팩스로 보내 주세요.

easy: To turn on and off quickly again and again.

ex.en: The lights flicked on and off during the storm.
ex.ko: 폭풍우가 치는 동안 불이 깜박거렸다.

easy: A man on the day he gets married.

ex.en: The groom smiled when he saw his bride.
ex.ko: 신랑은 신부를 보고 활짝 웃었다.

easy: Careful about what you say or do because you are not sure.

ex.en: She gave a guarded answer because she was not sure.
ex.ko: 그녀는 확신이 없어서 조심스럽게 대답했다.

easy: A person who plays the guitar.

ex.en: The guitarist played my favorite song at the school show.
ex.ko: 기타 연주자가 학교 공연에서 내가 좋아하는 노래를 연주했다.

easy: The rest time in the middle of a game.

ex.en: At halftime we drank water and ate orange slices.
ex.ko: 하프타임에 우리는 물을 마시고 오렌지 조각을 먹었다.

easy: A kind of tree with leaves that smell nice.

ex.en: A laurel tree has leaves that smell good.
ex.ko: 월계수는 잎에서 좋은 냄새가 난다.

easy: A ring of leaves worn on the head by a winner long ago.

ex.en: The winner of the race wore a laurel wreath on his head.
ex.ko: 경주 우승자는 머리에 월계관을 썼다.

easy: Full of deep, beautiful feeling, like a song or poem.

ex.en: The dancer's lyrical dance made the audience cry.
ex.ko: 그 무용수의 서정적인 춤은 관객들을 울렸다.

easy: To make something as big or as much as you can.

ex.en: Let's maximize our time at the park by going early.
ex.ko: 일찍 가서 공원에서 보내는 시간을 최대한 늘리자.

easy: To use something in the best way to get the most from it.

ex.en: She maximized her chance by practicing every day.
ex.ko: 그녀는 매일 연습해서 자신의 기회를 최대한 살렸다.

easy: In a way that is about what is right and wrong.

ex.en: Cheating on a test is morally wrong.
ex.ko: 시험에서 부정행위를 하는 것은 도덕적으로 잘못이다.

easy: In a good and right way.

ex.en: He acted morally and returned the lost wallet.
ex.ko: 그는 올바르게 행동해서 잃어버린 지갑을 돌려주었다.

easy: A statement that seems to say two opposite things at once.

ex.en: A sign that says "Ignore this sign" is a paradox.
ex.ko: '이 표지판을 무시하세요'라고 쓴 표지판은 역설이다.

easy: In a quiet and calm way.

ex.en: The baby slept peacefully in the car.
ex.ko: 아기는 차 안에서 평화롭게 잤다.

easy: Happening again and again after the same amount of time.

ex.en: Periodic fire drills happen at our school every month.
ex.ko: 우리 학교에서는 주기적으로 매달 소방 훈련을 한다.

easy: A small raised stage for a speaker or a winner.

ex.en: The winner stepped onto the podium to get her medal.
ex.ko: 우승자는 메달을 받으려고 단상에 올랐다.

easy: To describe someone or something in words.

ex.en: The story portrays the dog as brave and kind.
ex.ko: 그 이야기는 개를 용감하고 착하게 묘사한다.

easy: To draw or paint a picture of a person.

ex.en: The artist portrayed our teacher in a painting.
ex.ko: 화가는 우리 선생님을 그림으로 그렸다.

easy: The flat black rubber disk that players hit in ice hockey.

ex.en: The player hit the puck into the goal.
ex.ko: 선수가 퍽을 골대에 쳐 넣었다.

easy: To think about something again, and maybe change your mind.

ex.en: Please reconsider and let us have a puppy.
ex.ko: 다시 생각해 보시고 강아지를 키우게 해 주세요.

easy: To stop yourself from doing something you want to do.

ex.en: I refrained from eating the cake before dinner.
ex.ko: 나는 저녁 먹기 전에 케이크를 먹고 싶은 걸 참았다.

easy: A special ceremony that a religion says people should do.

ex.en: Baptism is a rite in many churches.
ex.ko: 세례는 많은 교회에서 하는 종교 의식이다.

easy: Something people always do in the same way.

ex.en: Blowing out candles is a birthday rite.
ex.ko: 촛불을 끄는 것은 생일의 의식이다.

easy: A trip to see wild animals, often in Africa.

ex.en: We saw lions and zebras on a safari in Africa.
ex.ko: 우리는 아프리카 사파리에서 사자와 얼룩말을 보았다.

easy: A player who gets points or goals in a game.

ex.en: Our best scorer made three goals today.
ex.ko: 우리 팀 최고의 득점자가 오늘 세 골을 넣었다.

easy: A person who owns a small part of a company.

ex.en: Grandpa is a shareholder of a toy company.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 장난감 회사의 주주이다.

easy: A bean plant used to make foods like tofu.

ex.en: Tofu and soy milk are made from soy.
ex.ko: 두부와 두유는 콩으로 만든다.

easy: A bushy bean plant that farmers grow for its seeds.

ex.en: Farmers grow soy in big fields.
ex.ko: 농부들은 넓은 밭에서 콩을 키운다.

easy: Put in a pile, one thing on top of another.

ex.en: The books were stacked high on my desk.
ex.ko: 책들이 내 책상 위에 높이 쌓여 있었다.

easy: In every part of one state.

ex.en: The statewide spelling contest had kids from every town.
ex.ko: 주 전체 철자 대회에는 모든 마을의 아이들이 참가했다.

easy: Not moving.

ex.en: The car stayed stationary at the red light.
ex.ko: 자동차는 빨간불에서 멈춰 서 있었다.

easy: Fixed in one place and not able to move.

ex.en: The stationary bike in the gym stays in one place.
ex.ko: 체육관의 고정식 자전거는 한 자리에 그대로 있다.

easy: A neighborhood of new houses built on land that was split into lots.

ex.en: We live in a subdivision with many new houses.
ex.ko: 우리는 새집이 많은 주택 단지에 산다.

easy: Coming next, after something else.

ex.en: In the succeeding days, the snow slowly melted.
ex.ko: 그 뒤 며칠 동안 눈이 천천히 녹았다.

easy: A thick, black, sticky stuff used to cover roads and roofs.

ex.en: Workers poured hot tar on the road.
ex.ko: 일꾼들이 도로에 뜨거운 타르를 부었다.

easy: A person who follows footprints to find an animal.

ex.en: The tracker followed the deer's footprints in the snow.
ex.ko: 추적자는 눈 위의 사슴 발자국을 따라갔다.

easy: A machine with blades that spin when wind, water, or steam pushes them.

ex.en: The big wind turbine spun in the breeze.
ex.ko: 커다란 풍력 터빈이 바람에 돌아갔다.

easy: Not there for you to get or use.
ko: 이용할 수 없는, 구할 수 없는

ex.en: The book I wanted was unavailable at the library.
ex.ko: 내가 원한 책은 도서관에 없어서 빌릴 수 없었다.

easy: Every time, without any exceptions.

ex.en: Pizza day is universally loved at our school.
ex.ko: 우리 학교에서 피자 데이는 모두가 좋아한다.

easy: Having bad luck.

ex.en: I was unlucky and lost my lunch money.
ex.ko: 나는 운이 나빠서 점심값을 잃어버렸다.

easy: Likely to have bad things happen.

ex.en: Some people think the number 13 is unlucky.
ex.ko: 어떤 사람들은 숫자 13이 불길하다고 생각한다.

easy: Light from the sun that you cannot see but that can burn your skin.

ex.en: Sunscreen protects your skin from UV light.
ex.ko: 자외선 차단제는 피부를 자외선으로부터 보호해 준다.

easy: When food comes back up from your stomach and out of your mouth.

ex.en: The flu gave me a fever and vomiting.
ex.ko: 독감 때문에 열이 나고 토를 했다.

easy: A bend or twist in something flat, like a board.

ex.en: The wet board had a warp in the middle.
ex.ko: 젖은 판자는 가운데가 휘어 있었다.

easy: A creamy, slightly sour food made from milk.

ex.en: I eat yogurt with berries for breakfast.
ex.ko: 나는 아침에 딸기를 넣은 요구르트를 먹는다.

easy: About the high Alps mountains.

ex.en: We watched alpine skiing at the Winter Olympics.
ex.ko: 우리는 동계 올림픽에서 알파인 스키를 보았다.

easy: Living or growing high on a mountain.

ex.en: Tiny alpine flowers grow high on the mountain.
ex.ko: 작은 고산 식물의 꽃들이 산 높은 곳에서 자란다.

easy: All around you.

ex.en: The ambient air in the room was warm.
ex.ko: 방 안의 주변 공기는 따뜻했다.

easy: Having to do with water.

ex.en: A pond is an aquatic home for frogs.
ex.ko: 연못은 개구리들의 물속 보금자리이다.

easy: Living or growing in water.

ex.en: Fish and whales are aquatic animals.
ex.ko: 물고기와 고래는 물에서 사는 동물이다.

easy: Covered with strong metal to keep safe.

ex.en: The armored truck carried money to the bank.
ex.ko: 장갑 트럭이 돈을 은행으로 실어 날랐다.

easy: To say something strongly because you believe it is true.

ex.en: She asserted that she did not break the vase.
ex.ko: 그녀는 꽃병을 깨뜨리지 않았다고 주장했다.

easy: How much information can move through an internet line at one time.

ex.en: Our video call froze because we had low bandwidth.
ex.ko: 대역폭이 낮아서 우리 화상 통화가 멈췄다.

easy: Meat cooked on a grill with a tasty sauce.

ex.en: Dad served barbecue chicken at the picnic.
ex.ko: 아빠는 소풍에서 바비큐 치킨을 내놓으셨다.

easy: An outdoor party where food is cooked over a fire.

ex.en: We had a barbecue in the backyard on Sunday.
ex.ko: 우리는 일요일에 뒷마당에서 바비큐 파티를 했다.

easy: Working to get people to vote for you.

ex.en: Mia's campaigning for class president included posters and speeches.
ex.ko: 미아의 반장 선거운동에는 포스터와 연설이 있었다.

easy: Kept in a metal can or glass jar so it stays fresh.

ex.en: We ate canned beans for dinner when we went camping.
ex.ko: 우리는 캠핑 가서 통조림 콩으로 저녁을 먹었다.

easy: A long line of people and animals traveling together.

ex.en: A caravan of camels crossed the desert.
ex.ko: 낙타 행렬이 사막을 가로질렀다.

easy: A vehicle with beds and a kitchen that a family can live in on trips.

ex.en: Our family traveled in a caravan across the country.
ex.ko: 우리 가족은 캠핑카로 나라 곳곳을 여행했다.

easy: A long, orange vegetable that grows under the ground.

ex.en: The rabbit ate a crunchy carrot.
ex.ko: 토끼가 아삭아삭한 당근을 먹었다.

easy: Squeezed into a smaller space.

ex.en: Compressed air fills the bike tires.
ex.ko: 압축된 공기가 자전거 타이어를 채운다.

easy: To be made up of certain parts.

ex.en: Our class comprises twenty kids.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 스무 명의 아이들로 이루어져 있다.

easy: About ideas, not real things.

ex.en: Before building the robot, we made a conceptual drawing of it.
ex.ko: 로봇을 만들기 전에 우리는 개념 설계도를 그렸다.

easy: Knocking down a building on purpose.

ex.en: The demolition of the old building was very loud.
ex.ko: 낡은 건물의 철거는 매우 시끄러웠다.

easy: Feeling sad and not hopeful anymore.

ex.en: He felt discouraged after losing the game.
ex.ko: 그는 경기에 지고 나서 낙담했다.

easy: A gray animal like a small horse with long ears, used to carry loads.

ex.en: The donkey carried bags up the hill.
ex.ko: 당나귀가 짐 가방을 언덕 위로 날랐다.

easy: Down the river, the same way the water flows.

ex.en: The raft floated downstream toward the sea.
ex.ko: 뗏목은 바다를 향해 강 아래로 떠내려갔다.

easy: Made bigger, like a picture.

ex.en: Mom hung an enlarged photo of our trip on the wall.
ex.ko: 엄마는 우리 여행 사진을 확대해서 벽에 거셨다.

easy: Broken or not working right.

ex.en: The faulty toy would not turn on.
ex.ko: 결함이 있는 장난감은 켜지지 않았다.

easy: Wrong because of mistakes.

ex.en: My math answer was faulty because I added wrong.
ex.ko: 나는 덧셈을 잘못해서 수학 답이 틀렸다.

easy: A long, angry fight between two people or families.

ex.en: The two families had a feud over a fence.
ex.ko: 두 가족은 울타리 문제로 오랫동안 반목했다.

easy: To keep fighting or arguing for a long time.

ex.en: The cousins feuded for a week over a game.
ex.ko: 사촌들은 게임 때문에 일주일 내내 다투었다.

easy: A person who makes movies.

ex.en: The filmmaker made a movie about our town.
ex.ko: 그 영화 제작자는 우리 마을에 대한 영화를 만들었다.

easy: A big heater that makes heat for a building.

ex.en: The furnace in the basement keeps our house warm.
ex.ko: 지하실의 난방 장치가 우리 집을 따뜻하게 해 준다.

easy: To melt from heat and stick together.

ex.en: The crayons fused together in the hot car.
ex.ko: 뜨거운 차 안에서 크레용들이 녹아 서로 붙었다.

easy: A loud, excited, upset mood or noisy trouble about a small thing.

ex.en: Everyone made a big fuss when the puppy got lost.
ex.ko: 강아지가 없어지자 모두가 야단법석을 떨었다.

easy: A very strong wind.

ex.en: A gale blew the leaves off every tree.
ex.ko: 강풍이 모든 나무의 잎을 날려 버렸다.

easy: Being happy to share your things or time.

ex.en: Her generosity showed when she shared her lunch.
ex.ko: 그녀가 점심을 나눠 주었을 때 그 너그러움이 드러났다.

easy: A sticky part of wheat that makes bread dough stretchy.

ex.en: Bread has gluten, which makes the dough stretchy.
ex.ko: 빵에는 반죽을 쫀득하게 만드는 글루텐이 들어 있다.

easy: The biggest ape, a strong animal that lives in African forests.

ex.en: The gorilla ate leaves at the zoo.
ex.ko: 고릴라가 동물원에서 나뭇잎을 먹었다.
